fdroid:org.scrib.transcriber.name: Scrib
fdroid:org.scrib.transcriber.summary: On-device voice transcription. Your audio never leaves your phone.
fdroid:org.scrib.transcriber.description:
Scrib turns speech into text entirely on your device, using open speech models. Nothing is uploaded — the app only goes online to download a model you choose.
Two ways to use it
• Transcribe your own audio. Pick any audio file on your phone and get the text, right in the app, fully offline.
• A transcription engine for other apps. Scrib also runs in the background. Apps that support it — such as Forkgram — can turn a voice message into text through Scrib, on your device. In that app's settings, choose Scrib as the offline transcriber.
Models
Scrib transcribes with open speech models — Whisper, Parakeet, SenseVoice, Canary, Moonshine, GigaAM and more — through one small ggml runtime. Download one on the main screen, or pick your language and Scrib fetches a suitable one. Larger models are more accurate but slower and bigger to download; keep several and switch any time. You can also add any compatible model by direct link, or import a file from your device. Models are downloaded separately and are not bundled in the app. The sherpa-only families — streaming Zipformer, Dolphin, FireRed — ship as Scrib Max on GitHub.
Privacy
Transcription runs 100% on device. Your voice messages never leave your phone. The only network access is downloading a speech model you pick.
For developers
Any app can use Scrib as an offline transcriber through the open Open Transcribe contract (org.opentranscribe.api) — a small AIDL service, no SDK and no network. The contract is vendor-neutral, so apps aren't tied to Scrib: they can bind any compatible transcriber the user has installed.

fedora-packages:gap-pkg-circle/gap-pkg-c.name: gap-pkg-circle
fedora-packages:gap-pkg-circle/gap-pkg-c.description: Let R be an associative ring, not necessarily with a unit element. The set of all elements of R forms a monoid with the neutral element 0 from R under the operation r*s = r + s + rs defined for all r,s from R. This operation is called 'circle multiplication'; it is also known as 'star multiplication'. The monoid of elements of R under circle multiplication is called the adjoint semigroup of R. The group of all invertible elements of this monoid is called the adjoint group of R. These notions naturally lead to a number of questions about the connection between a ring and its adjoint group, for example, how the ring properties will determine properties of the adjoint group; which groups can appear as adjoint groups of rings; which rings can have adjoint groups with prescribed properties, etc. The main objective of the GAP package 'Circle' is to extend GAP functionality for computations in adjoint groups of associative rings to make it possible to use the GAP system for the investigation of such questions. Circle provides functionality to construct circle objects that will respect circle multiplication r*s = r + s + rs, create multiplicative groups, generated by these objects, and compute groups of elements, invertible with respect to this operation, for finite radical algebras and finite associative rings without one.

firefox-addons:2999103.summary: Protects the current tab with a local privacy overlay as soon as the mouse pointer leaves the browser window.
firefox-addons:2999103.description:
Tab Privacy-Overlay adds a local privacy-screen feature for the current tab to Firefox.
After activation via the toolbar icon, the tab behaves normally as long as the mouse pointer remains inside the browser window. As soon as the pointer leaves the window, the visible page area is covered by a local overlay page. If the corresponding option is enabled, the overlay is only hidden again once the mouse pointer has returned to the window and Ctrl is also pressed.
The overlay content is loaded exclusively locally. Instead of embedding external pages, the extension displays a Markdown page from the settings. This avoids cookie banners, embedding issues, and other side effects of external content.
Features:
 Enable and disable per tab
 Local overlay page based on Markdown
 Edit Markdown in the settings
 Import and export Markdown
 Optional requirement to press Ctrl to hide the overlay
 Optional best-effort pause of HTML5 videos when the overlay appears
 Quick access to the settings via the right-click menu on the add-on icon
The extension stores its settings only locally in Firefox and does not transmit browsing data to external services.

🧾 How to Use 
You can add your Patreon.com creators to the extension with 3 ways. Before adding your creators we suggest to complete these 3 things first:
1. Sign in to your Patreon.com account
2. Subscribe to a Patreon.com creator
3. Sign in to the browser extension within your browser
➤ The first way is automatic and available only for Chrome users. Steps:
1. Click the browser extension (Home tab) and click the 'Import creators from Patreon' button. Follow the instructions on the consent screen
All creators you currently support, or have supported in the past, will be added to the extension (Creators Tab)
2. Click the 'Downloads Page' button. It isn't required to have the Patreon.com page opened in your browser
➤ The second way is also automatic. Steps:
1. Sign in to https://patreon.cosmious.com 
2. Visit the My Creators page: https://patreon.cosmious.com/my-creators 
3. Click the 'Continue with Patreon' button in Import creators from Patreon section. Follow the instructions on the consent screen
All creators you currently support, or have supported in the past, will be loaded. You can choose which ones to add
4. Click the 'Downloads Page' in the browser extension
➤ The third way is also automatic. Steps:
1. Visit the Patreon.com creator's home page
2. Click the browser extension (Home tab) and wait until the creator is detected
3. Click the 'Downloads Page' button. The creator will be added to your creator's list. It isn't required to have the Patreon.com page opened in your browser
➤ The fourth way is manual. Steps:
1. Click the browser extension and then click the 'Add creators' button
2. Type the creator's name in the search box and it will appear in the search results
3. Click the 'Add creator' icon next to the creator's name and it will be added to your creator's list
4. Click the 'Downloads Page' button
➤ The fifth way is manual. Steps:
1. Sign in to https://patreon.cosmious.com 
2. Visit the My Creators page: https://patreon.cosmious.com/my-creators 
3. The 'Add creators' section will appear
4. Type the creator's name in the search box and it will appear in the search results
5. Click the 'Add creator' icon next to the creator's name and it will be added to your creator's list
6. Click the 'Downloads Page' in the browser extension

- List files from creator's posts
- Search & filter files by file type, post, state
- Download attachments (any media type) into organized folders
- Various download settings
- Multiple mass download options

apple-macos:6825865288.name: Apportice: SSH & Cloud Shell
apple-macos:6825865288.description:
Apportice is a fast, private SSH client for Mac, iPhone and iPad, with AWS Session Manager built in. Connect to your servers over SSH, or open a shell on any EC2 instance without SSH keys or open ports, all from one app.
EVERY SERVER, ONE KEYSTROKE AWAY
• Quick Connect: type user@host, a saved server or an EC2 instance and you're in
• Save servers once with their host, port, user and key, then connect with a tap or double-click
• Recent SSH and AWS sessions on the Home screen, plus a full connection history
• Run many SSH and Session Manager terminals at once and switch between them instantly
• Keyboard shortcuts for new connections, switching sessions and disconnecting
SHELL INTO EC2, NO SSH NEEDED
• Open Session Manager shells on EC2 instances registered with AWS Systems Manager
• No bastion hosts, no inbound ports, no SSH keys to hand out
• Sign in the way you already do: AWS console sign-in (with MFA), IAM Identity Center, or access keys
• Short-term credentials renew automatically for as long as your sign-in allows
• Paste credentials straight from the AWS access portal or the AWS CLI
• Add as many accounts and regions as you need
KEYS THAT NEVER LEAVE YOUR DEVICE
• Generate Secure Enclave keys: the private key is created inside your device's security hardware and can never be copied out
• Import Ed25519 and ECDSA (P-256, P-384, P-521) keys, including passphrase-protected OpenSSH keys
• Keys and AWS credentials live in the Keychain, unlocked with Face ID or Touch ID
• Copy or share any public key in one tap to add it to authorized_keys
• AWS accounts lock again after the period of inactivity you choose
SECURITY YOU CAN VERIFY
• Every new server's host key fingerprint is shown before you connect
• A clear warning if a server's key ever changes, so an intercepted connection doesn't go unnoticed
• Sign in with a key or a password
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No accounts, no analytics, no tracking
• Apportice talks only to the servers you connect to, and to AWS when you use it
• Your servers, keys and history stay on your device
Session Manager needs the SSM Agent on your instances and an IAM role that allows Systems Manager (for example AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore). The in-app Support page walks through setup and common problems.
